en: Proverbs 5

p.src: 1  My son, pay attention to my wisdom. Turn your ear to my understanding,

en: My son, pay attention to my wisdom. Turn your ear to my understanding,
u.src: 1  My son, pay attention to my wisdom. Turn your ear to my understanding,

p.src: 2  that you may maintain discretion, that your lips may preserve knowledge.

en: that you may maintain discretion, that your lips may preserve knowledge.
u.src: 2  that you may maintain discretion, that your lips may preserve knowledge.

p.src: 3  For the lips of an adulteress drip honey. Her mouth is smoother than oil,

en: For the lips of an adulteress drip honey. Her mouth is smoother than oil,
u.src: 3  For the lips of an adulteress drip honey. Her mouth is smoother than oil,

p.src: 4  but in the end she is as bitter as wormwood, and as sharp as a two-edged sword.

en: but in the end she is as bitter as wormwood, and as sharp as a two-edged sword.
u.src: 4  but in the end she is as bitter as wormwood, and as sharp as a two-edged sword.

p.src: 5  Her feet go down to death. Her steps lead straight to Sheol.

en: Her feet go down to death. Her steps lead straight to Sheol.
u.src: 5  Her feet go down to death. Her steps lead straight to Sheol.

en: 5:5 Sheol is the place of the dead.

p.src: 6  She gives no thought to the way of life. Her ways are crooked, and she doesn’t know it.

en: She gives no thought to the way of life. Her ways are crooked, and she doesn’t know it.
u.src: 6  She gives no thought to the way of life. Her ways are crooked, and she doesn’t know it.

p.src: 7  Now therefore, my sons, listen to me. Don’t depart from the words of my mouth.

en: Now therefore, my sons, listen to me. Don’t depart from the words of my mouth.
u.src: 7  Now therefore, my sons, listen to me. Don’t depart from the words of my mouth.

p.src: 8  Remove your way far from her. Don’t come near the door of her house,

en: Remove your way far from her. Don’t come near the door of her house,
u.src: 8  Remove your way far from her. Don’t come near the door of her house,

p.src: 9  lest you give your honor to others, and your years to the cruel one;

en: lest you give your honor to others, and your years to the cruel one;
u.src: 9  lest you give your honor to others, and your years to the cruel one;

p.src: 10  lest strangers feast on your wealth, and your labors enrich another man’s house.

en: lest strangers feast on your wealth, and your labors enrich another man’s house.
u.src: 10  lest strangers feast on your wealth, and your labors enrich another man’s house.

p.src: 11  You will groan at your latter end, when your flesh and your body are consumed,

en: You will groan at your latter end, when your flesh and your body are consumed,
u.src: 11  You will groan at your latter end, when your flesh and your body are consumed,

p.src: 12  and say, “How I have hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof.

en: and say, “How I have hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof.
u.src: 12  and say, “How I have hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof.

p.src: 13  I haven’t obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor turned my ear to those who instructed me!

en: I haven’t obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor turned my ear to those who instructed me!
u.src: 13  I haven’t obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor turned my ear to those who instructed me!

p.src: 14  I have come to the brink of utter ruin, among the gathered assembly.”

en: I have come to the brink of utter ruin, among the gathered assembly.”
u.src: 14  I have come to the brink of utter ruin, among the gathered assembly.”

p.src: 15  Drink water out of your own cistern, running water out of your own well.

en: Drink water out of your own cistern, running water out of your own well.
u.src: 15  Drink water out of your own cistern, running water out of your own well.

p.src: 16  Should your springs overflow in the streets, streams of water in the public squares?

en: Should your springs overflow in the streets, streams of water in the public squares?
u.src: 16  Should your springs overflow in the streets, streams of water in the public squares?

p.src: 17  Let them be for yourself alone, not for strangers with you.

en: Let them be for yourself alone, not for strangers with you.
u.src: 17  Let them be for yourself alone, not for strangers with you.

p.src: 18  Let your spring be blessed. Rejoice in the wife of your youth.

en: Let your spring be blessed. Rejoice in the wife of your youth.
u.src: 18  Let your spring be blessed. Rejoice in the wife of your youth.

p.src: 19  A loving doe and a graceful deer— let her breasts satisfy you at all times. Be captivated always with her love.

en: A loving doe and a graceful deer— let her breasts satisfy you at all times. Be captivated always with her love.
u.src: 19  A loving doe and a graceful deer— let her breasts satisfy you at all times. Be captivated always with her love.

p.src: 20  For why should you, my son, be captivated with an adulteress? Why embrace the bosom of another?

en: For why should you, my son, be captivated with an adulteress? Why embrace the bosom of another?
u.src: 20  For why should you, my son, be captivated with an adulteress? Why embrace the bosom of another?

p.src: 21  For the ways of man are before the LORD’s eyes. He examines all his paths.

en: For the ways of man are before the LORD’s eyes. He examines all his paths.
u.src: 21  For the ways of man are before the LORD’s eyes. He examines all his paths.

p.src: 22  The evil deeds of the wicked ensnare him. The cords of his sin hold him firmly.

en: The evil deeds of the wicked ensnare him. The cords of his sin hold him firmly.
u.src: 22  The evil deeds of the wicked ensnare him. The cords of his sin hold him firmly.

p.src: 23  He will die for lack of instruction. In the greatness of his folly, he will go astray.

en: He will die for lack of instruction. In the greatness of his folly, he will go astray.
u.src: 23  He will die for lack of instruction. In the greatness of his folly, he will go astray.
